title: telis corniculata
intro: Telis corniculata, commonly known as Sida cordifolia, is a plant species in the Malvaceae family that has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Sida cordifolia include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have anti-cancer and anti-viral activities.
